query: Set up proper routine management for me. I already have a couple of routines I made by hand.
setup: Two deployed routines exist without the '(routine-architect)' suffix: a nightly digest and a scraper alert fixer with its audit list baked into its prompt. No watchdog exists.
expected_behavior: Enters bootstrap mode (no managed watchdog found) but does NOT propose duplicates of the two existing routines
Offers per-routine: adopt into the manifest (entry mirroring live config, including declaring artifact contracts for what they already produce) or acknowledge as unmanaged
For adopted routines, renames the deployment to add the '(routine-architect)' suffix or records the exception explicitly
Writes prompt files capturing the EXACT deployed prompts byte-for-byte so drift detection works from day one
Runs scripts/validate_fleet.py and resolves findings before deploying the watchdog
Deploys the watchdog with sources covering the ops repo plus every repo in adopted artifact contracts, and explains that future changes go through reconcile runs
